plugins.name: glm-foxgirl
plugins.description: GLM Foxgirl persona companion bot for QQ and WeChat: ZCode acts as the brain; NapCat carries QQ traffic; ADB drives WeChat on an emulator or USB phone. Persona library with hot-switching commands, semantic vector memory, video frame understanding, sticker auto-collection, poke interactions, SQLite long-term memory, relationship profiles, blacklist/whitelist, human-like rate limiting, proactive chat, scheduled heartbeat.

description_i18n.zh-CN: GLM狐狸娘 · QQ/微信人格机器人：配置页/聊天区分工、会话接力换页记忆不丢、记录追溯导出、人格库热切换、语义记忆+遗忘曲线、记忆图、无障碍读屏精确发言人、视频识别、表情包自动收集、戳一戳、黑白名单、拟人防风控、本地 WebUI。QQ 走 NapCat，微信走 ADB。
